mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( user_id, comment_content, target_id, target_type, parent_comment_id) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{commentContent}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{parentCommentId} )
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, c.parent_comment_id AS parentCommentId, c.comment_content AS commentContent, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.modified_at AS modifiedAt, c.is_deleted AS isDeleted, c.target_id AS targetId, c.target_type AS targetType FROM comments c JOIN user_detail u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
